# Nov20 Italian proposal, NOT independently reviewed or published

Candidate source: https://www.istat.it/comunicato-stampa/incidenti-stradali-stima-preliminare-gennaio-giugno-2026/
Full official report: https://www.istat.it/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/REPORT_INCIDENTISTRADALI_PRIMO_SEMESTRE_2026.pdf
Rights: https://www.istat.it/note-legali/
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

## Freshness / independent work
Checked 2026-11-20. Official page explicitly labels Data pubblicazione 18 Novembre 2026 and reference period Gennaio-giugno 2026. PDF itself begins 18 novembre 2026 and covers the new preliminary 2026 first-half estimates. Page also reports graphs replaced at12:46 on Nov18; this is an intra-day correction to graphs, not evidence of an older text. No earlier publication date found. Latest displayed publication date and the report's date agree; this is positive first-publication evidence, not simply a URL/year guess. Original Italian on institutional Italian site; not an English/translated locale.

Searched current data/reading + editorial/reading for URL, title, incidenti-stradali, ACI and read the existing closest article 2026-10-23-it-strade-leggere-i-confronti. Existing work is provincial extension of 2025 annual results, original October15, national data originally July24. New work is Jan-Jun2026 preliminary release, after Nov4–7 missing records; not an old backfill or alternative level of the same source work. Nevertheless thematic overlap exists: both explain comparison periods and opposite injury/death trends. New edition primarily highlights motorway vs urban/other road contrast, which is not the old province contrast. Coordinator should reject if topic repetition outweighs this incremental value; do not force a quota.

## Rights and third parties
Istat legal notice license section explicitly allows modification and commercial redistribution under CC BY4 unless otherwise marked. Its third-party exclusion applies to third-party content, logos/images/trademarks. Full 8-page report text inspected, no contrary copyright/licence/rights reservation found. Main crash results and tables are attributed to Istat's road injury accident survey. Methodological note mentions ACI participation and local authorities; this is acknowledged in adaptation attribution rather than erased.

Specific exclusions: report page1 footnote2 identifies ACI automobile register, municipal data, Autostrade per l'Italia and Anas as sources of CONTEXT data. Proposed adaptation excludes all vehicle registration/market, sharing/mobility and traffic-volume material from those sources. Excludes graphics, logos, and separately sourced quoted road-accident definition (Vienna Convention/UNECE/ITF/Eurostat). No claim that ACI's external site or external works inherit Istat CC BY. Used institutional narration and statistical facts only. Thirty-day death inclusion also appears explicitly in Istat's opening paragraph, so no outside definition needs reproducing.

## Claim map
s1–s2: official publication date and reference period; preliminary status stated in title/opening.
s3–s4: official opening, accidents and injuries higher than Jan-Jun2025, deaths lower.
s5: official opening specifies deaths within30days; PDF glossary confirms.
s6–s8: official fourth paragraph, motorway deaths increase, urban/extraurban deaths decrease, comparison first half2025.
s9–s10: official second/third paragraphs, 2019 baseline and death decrease vs that semester; continued road-safety work needed.
No exact counts or percentages in reading, only dates and death-counting interval. Body160 whitespace words. Dates in narrative are source date rather than edition date; edition Nov20.

## Artifacts
article.json, practice.json (5cloze), comprehension.json (3questions), source.pdf, source.txt, source-page.html, rights.html. Private files only. Build script retained as initial draft only; final JSON includes reviewer revisions, do not rerun build.py. Await independent source/content/answer-blind review and coordinator schema/batch/UI gates.
